verses.ar: وَبَرَزَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَاضِعًا يَدَيْهِ عَلٰى الْأَرْضِ رَافِعًا رَأْسَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الْعَلِيَّةْ ۞ مُومِيًا بِذَلِكَ الرَّفْعِ إِلَى سُؤْدَدِهِ وَعُلَاهْ ۞ وَمُشِيرًا إِلَى رِفْعَةِ قَدْرِهِ عَلٰى سَائِرِ الْبَرِيَّةْ ۞ وَأَنَّهُ الْحَبِيبُ الَّذِي حَسُنَتْ طِبَاعُهُ وَسَجَايَاهْ ۞ وَدَعَتْ أُمُّهُ عَبْدَ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَهُوَ يَطُوفُ بِهَاتِيكَ الْبَنِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-baraza ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama wāḍiʿan yadayhi ʿalā l-arḍi rāfiʿan ra'sahu ilā s-samā'i l-ʿaliyyah, mūmiyan bi-dhālika r-rafʿi ilā su'dadihi wa-ʿulāh, wa-mushīran ilā rifʿati qadrihi ʿalā sā'iri l-bariyyah, wa-annahu l-ḥabību lladhī ḥasunat ṭibāʿuhu wa-sajāyāh, wa-daʿat ummuhu ʿAbda l-Muṭṭalibi wa-huwa yaṭūfu bi-hātīka l-baniyyah.
verses.en: He, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, emerged with his hands placed upon the earth and his head raised towards the lofty heavens, alluding through this raising to his nobility and exalted rank, and indicating the loftiness of his station above all creation, and that he is the Beloved whose nature and character are beautiful. His mother then called for Abd al-Muttalib while he was circumambulating that Sacred House.

verses.ar: فَأَقْبَلَ مُسْرِعًا وَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ وَبَلَغَ مِنَ السُّرُورِ مُنَاهْ ۞ وَأَدْخَلَهُ الْكَعْبَةَ الْغَرَّاءَ وَقَامَ يَدْعُو بِخُلُوصِ النِّيَّةْ ۞ وَيَشْكُرُ اللّٰهَ تَعَالَى عَلٰى مَا مَنَّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ وَأَعْطَاهْ ۞ وَوُلِدَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَظِيفًا مَخْتُونًا مَقْطُوعَ السُّرِّ بِيَدِ الْقُدْرَةِ الْإِلَهِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Fa-aqbala musriʿan wa-naẓara ilayhi wa-balagha mina s-surūri munāh, wa-adkhalahu l-kaʿbata l-gharrā'a wa-qāma yadʿū bi-khulūṣi n-niyyah, wa-yash-kuru Llāha taʿālā ʿalā mā manna bihi ʿalayhi wa-aʿṭāh, wa-wulida ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama naẓīfan makhtūnan maqṭūʿa s-surri bi-yadi l-qudrati l-ilāhiyyah.
verses.en: And he came quickly, looked upon him, and attained the fullness of his joy. He took him into the radiant Ka'bah and stood supplicating with sincere intention, and thanking Allah Most High for what He had graciously bestowed upon him and given him. And he, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, was born clean, circumcised, and with his umbilical cord severed by the hand of Divine Power.

verses.ar: طَيِّبًا دَهِينًا مَكْحُولَةً بِكُحْلِ الْعِنَايَةِ عَيْنَاهْ ۞ وَقِيلَ خَتَنَهُ جَدُّهُ بَعْدَ سَبْعِ لَيَالٍ سَوِيَّةْ ۞ وَأَوْلَمَ وَأَطْعَمَ وَسَمَّاهُ مُحَمَّدًا وَأَكْرَمَ مَثْوَاهْ
verses.tr: Ṭayyiban dahīnan makḥūlatan bi-kuḥli l-ʿināyati ʿaynāh, wa-qīla khatanahu jadduhu baʿda sabʿi layālin sawiyyah, wa-awlama wa-aṭʿama wa-sammāhu Muḥammadan wa-akrama mathwāh.
verses.en: Fragrant and anointed, with his eyes lined with the kohl of Divine Care. And it is said that his grandfather circumcised him after seven full nights, held a feast and fed the people, named him Muhammad, and honoured his abode.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
